branch.description:
If branch is provided, will pull from this branch than previously configured branch.
On success, Will update the configured branch to be the given branch.

reset.description:
If reset is true, remote branch contents will be replacing Pkg.Store and any unpublished changes will be lost.
If reset is false, the changes in Pkg.store will be applied on latest from remote branch.

commitSha.description: pull from this commit, if that commit is part of configured branch history, otherwise fail.

useRemote.description:
When true, When there are conflicting changes in files,
accept changes from remote branch and reject local. `false` would accept local changes.
This is applied when `reset` is false.
